slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the demand at each demand point j required to be fully satisfied (i.e., total inflow to j must equal b_j), or is it allowed to be only partially satisfied (inflow at most b_j)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be exactly satisfied or can be partial, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost equals the sum of all unit transportation costs (for both the production-to-station and station-to-demand legs) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included both transportation and fixed costs, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before the agent stopped; no P0/P1 slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked clear, targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots early in the interview, then continued with many low-value repeated questions before stopping. The interaction quality is adequate for hidden-slot recovery but includes substantial over-questioning.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
